Class QwenAiService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.QwenAiService
public class QwenAiService extends Object
HTTP client for the DashScope OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint powering resume coaching workflows.

The dual entry points exercised by production JSP backing code are resume optimisation (VL capable) versus batch scoring/text reasoning (deterministic JSON via the complementary text-weighted models).

Configure credentials through QWEN_API_KEY (System.getenv(String)) and optional overrides QWEN_MODEL plus QWEN_TEXT_MODEL sourced from JVM system properties then environment variables.

    • analyzeResumeForOptimization

      public String analyzeResumeForOptimization(String title, String department, String degreeLevel, String gpa, String bio, String uploadedFile, List<String> vacancyContext) throws Exception
      Analyses a student's resume and returns coaching advice on how to improve it. If an image/txt file is attached, it performs multimodal analysis.
      Parameters:
      title - resume title
      department - applicant's department
      degreeLevel - e.g. "MASTER"
      gpa - GPA string
      bio - personal statement
      uploadedFile - path to uploaded file (jpg/png/txt/pdf/docx), or null
      vacancyContext - list of vacancy titles for context (to tailor suggestions)
      Returns:
      markdown-formatted improvement advice
      Throws:
      Exception

    • batchScoreJobs

      public Map<String,Integer> batchScoreJobs(String title, String department, String degree, String gpa, String bio, List<QwenAiService.JobInfo> jobs) throws Exception
      Scores how well the student's resume matches each of the given TA jobs.
      Parameters:
      title - resume title (may be null)
      department - applicant's department
      degree - degree level
      gpa - GPA string
      bio - personal statement
      jobs - list of jobs to score
      Returns:
      map of jobId to score (0-100). Missing entries mean scoring failed for that job.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • rankResumesForJob

      public Map<String,Integer> rankResumesForJob(String jobTitle, String jobDescription, String jobDepartment, List<QwenAiService.ResumeInfo> resumes) throws Exception
      Scores numerous resume snapshots against exactly one vacancy.
      Parameters:
      jobTitle - vacancy headline used to anchor prompting
      jobDescription - narrative excerpt describing duties and expectations
      jobDepartment - owning unit label for recruiter context
      resumes - structured resume payloads each supplying an explicit identifier key for JSON parsing
      Returns:
      map from resume identifiers to heuristic [0,100] scores; absent keys imply parsing drift
      Throws:
      Exception

    • rankMoApplicantsForJobJson

      public String rankMoApplicantsForJobJson(String jobTitle, String moduleCode, String jobDescription, String jobLabelsJoined, List<QwenAiService.MoApplicantSnippet> applicants) throws Exception
      Requests a JSON array comparing multiple TA applicants scoped to identical vacancy metadata.
      Parameters:
      jobTitle - vacancy headline surfaced to the organiser tooling
      moduleCode - curriculum identifier aiding disambiguation
      jobDescription - substantive description excerpt fed to comparative reasoning prompts
      jobLabelsJoined - comma-joined recruiter tags enriching context
      applicants - anonymised dossier payloads with stable QwenAiService.MoApplicantSnippet.applicationId keys
      Returns:
      raw assistant payload expected to encode a strictly parsed JSON array
      Throws:
      Exception
